policyIndex.name: Information Security Policy
policyIndex.purpose: The purpose of this policy is to communicate our information security policies and outline the acceptable use and protection of Nominal, Inc’s information and assets.

policyIndex.name: AC - Access Controls Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Defines requirements for controlling access to systems and data to ensure only authorized users have access.

policyIndex.name: AT - Awareness and Training Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Outlines the training and awareness programs to ensure personnel understand their security responsibilities.

policyIndex.name: AU - Audit and Accountability Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Establishes guidelines for auditing system activities and ensuring accountability for actions performed.

policyIndex.name: CA - Security Assessment and Authorization Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Outlines the process for assessing security controls and authorizing system operations.

policyIndex.name: CM - Configuration Management Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Details the processes for managing and documenting system configurations to maintain security integrity.

policyIndex.name: CP - Contingency Planning Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Specifies procedures for preparing for, responding to, and recovering from system disruptions or failures.

policyIndex.name: IA - Identification and Authentication Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Sets the standards for verifying user identities and managing authentication mechanisms for secure access.

policyIndex.name: IR - Incident Response Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Defines the process for identifying, reporting, and responding to security incidents within the system.

policyIndex.name: MA - Maintenance Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Outlines procedures for performing and managing system maintenance securely and efficiently.

policyIndex.name: MP - Media Protection Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Specifies requirements for protecting and handling media containing sensitive information.

policyIndex.name: PE - Physical and Environmental Protection Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Details the physical security measures to protect systems and data from environmental threats and unauthorized access.

policyIndex.name: PL - Planning Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Sets forth the procedures for developing, reviewing, and maintaining security plans for systems.

policyIndex.name: PS - Personnel Security Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Establishes guidelines for managing personnel security, including background checks and access approvals.

policyIndex.name: RA - Risk Assessment Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Establishes processes for identifying, assessing, and managing risks to information systems.

policyIndex.name: SA - System and Services Acquisition Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Sets the standards for acquiring systems and services, ensuring they meet security requirements.

policyIndex.name: SC - System and Communications Protection Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Details measures to protect the system and communications infrastructure from unauthorized access and threats.

policyIndex.name: SI - System and Information Integrity Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Defines procedures for ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and security of system information.

policyIndex.name: SR - Supply Chain Risk Management Policy
policyIndex.purpose: Establishes guidelines for identifying and mitigating supply chain risks to ensure the security of systems.

policyIndex.name: Acceptable Use Policy (AUP)
policyIndex.purpose: Rules of behavior for authorized use of Nominal information systems: roles and responsibilities, authorized use, account management and authentication, data classification and handling, email and electronic communications, internet and social media, mobile devices and remote access, physical security, and software and asset management (NIST SP 800-53 PL-4).

policyIndex.name: Operations Security Policy
policyIndex.purpose: To ensure the correct and secure operation of information processing systems and facilities.

policyIndex.name: Third-Party Risk Management Policy
policyIndex.purpose: To ensure protection of the organization's data and assets that are shared with, accessible to, or managed by suppliers, including external parties or third-party organizations such as service providers, vendors, and customers, and to maintain an agreed level of information security and service delivery in line with supplier agreements.

policyIndex.name: AC Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Describes the specific steps for implementing access control measures as per the policy.

policyIndex.name: AT Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Describes the steps for implementing and maintaining awareness and training programs.

policyIndex.name: AU Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Provides detailed instructions for auditing system activities and ensuring accountability.

policyIndex.name: CA Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Outlines the procedures for assessing security, authorizing system operations, and ongoing monitoring.

policyIndex.name: CM Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Specifies the procedures for controlling and documenting system configurations.

policyIndex.name: CP Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Provides detailed steps for developing and executing contingency plans for system disruptions.

policyIndex.name: IA Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Describes the procedures for verifying identities and managing authentication processes.

policyIndex.name: IR Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Provides detailed instructions for identifying, reporting, and responding to security incidents.

policyIndex.name: MA Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Specifies the procedures for securely conducting and documenting system maintenance activities.

policyIndex.name: MP Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Outlines the steps for protecting, handling, and disposing of media containing sensitive information.

policyIndex.name: PE Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Describes the procedures for implementing physical and environmental security measures.

policyIndex.name: PL Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Specifies the steps for developing and maintaining security plans for systems.

policyIndex.name: PS Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Provides detailed instructions for implementing personnel security measures, including background checks.

policyIndex.name: RA Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Outlines the procedures for conducting and documenting risk assessments.

policyIndex.name: SA Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Provides detailed steps for acquiring systems and services, ensuring that they comply with security requirements and meet the organization's operational needs.

policyIndex.name: SC Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Describes the specific procedures for protecting the system and communications infrastructure.

policyIndex.name: SI Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Outlines the procedures for maintaining the integrity of system information and ensuring its reliability.

policyIndex.name: SR Procedures
policyIndex.purpose: Provides detailed steps for identifying and mitigating supply chain risks to protect systems.

policyIndex.name: Incident Response Plan
policyIndex.purpose: Details the plan for responding to security incidents, including roles, responsibilities, and steps to take.

policyIndex.name: ConMon Plan
policyIndex.purpose: Outlines the plan for continuous monitoring of security controls and system activities.

policyIndex.name: Configuration Management Plan
policyIndex.purpose: Details the plan for managing system configurations to maintain security and operational integrity.

policyIndex.name: Information System Contingency Plan (ISCP)
policyIndex.purpose: Information system contingency plan for the Nominal core and corporate information systems: concept of operations, activation and notification, recovery and reconstitution; supersedes the Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan v4.0.

policyIndex.name: Supply Chain Risk Management Plan
policyIndex.purpose: Defines strategies for managing risks associated with the supply chain to protect system integrity.
